answer.text: The trade is well documented, the sharing between trees far less so
answer.line: Paragraph 17 states the split: the trade is measured and quantified, while how much the sharing matters stays open.

steps: Read the close first. Paragraph 17 sorts what is settled from what stays open.
Settled: "The trade of mineral nutrients for sugar and fat is measured and quantified."
Open: how much carbon movement matters, and whether provisioning happens at all. Paragraph 16 adds that the popular language ran ahead of the measurements.
Pick the choice that holds both halves.

choices.text: Ectomycorrhizal and arbuscular partners differ mainly in their fungal lineages
choices.note: The two types fill paragraphs 3 and 4, and the passage contrasts their structures, not lineages. Too narrow for the main idea.

choices.text: The trade is well documented, the sharing between trees far less so
choices.note: Settled trade, open sharing: paragraph 17 in one line.

choices.text: Isotope labelling has settled the question of how carbon moves between trees
choices.note: Paragraphs 11 to 13 list what labelling cannot settle, and paragraph 17 says the question stays open.

choices.text: Fungal networks join the trees of a forest into a single system of mutual care
choices.note: This is the web of nurture image that paragraph 16 says has run well ahead of the measurements.

choices.text: Phosphate scarcity is the one force that has shaped the evolution of land plants
choices.note: The one force behind all of plant evolution goes far beyond paragraph 5, which uses phosphate to explain why a tree pays.
